name: Appointment dashboard
description: A single dashboard shows all reservations, which can be sorted by date, time, or employee.
quote: Sort your reservations by date, time, or even by employee.

name: Automated and targeted promos with winback campaigns
description: Schedule promotions ahead of time, send them to specific customer groups, and win back customers who have stopped visiting.
cost_note: Customer Engagement Plus plan is $99/mo.
quote: Win with MIA customers through winback campaigns.

name: Automated win-back campaigns
description: Sends automatic outreach to bring back past customers, with targeted promos and birthday rewards.
cost_note: That's a lot more customer engagement power for just $99/mo.
quote: birthday rewards, automated win-back campaigns, and so much more

name: Automatic appointment confirmation emails
description: Customers automatically get a confirmation email once their appointment is booked.
quote: Send automatic confirmation emails to give them the peace of mind that their appointment is accurate and confirmed.

name: Clover Customers
description: Builds a customer list automatically from credit card sales with digital receipts, and lets owners update contact info and notes.
cost_note: It's simple, and comes free with your Clover system.
how_to_start: Take a credit card payment and have the customer request a digital receipt.
Ask the customer to tap "follow" on the digital receipt to opt in.
Update customer details, notes, birthdays, or food allergies from your Clover POS.
quote: It’s simple, and comes free with your Clover system.

name: Clover Feedback
description: Adds a customer code and invite to receipts so customers can send private feedback, which you can answer before it becomes a public review.
cost_note: It's simple and comes free with your Clover POS.
how_to_start: Open Feedback in your Clover POS and turn it on.
Add an automatic customer code to your receipts with an invite message.
Customers send feedback by SMS or in the Clover mobile app.
Reply right away, and check the email alerts for new feedback.
quote: Add an automatic customer code to your receipts, and a message inviting them to share their input.

name: Clover mobile app rewards and order ahead
description: A free customer app where shoppers earn rewards and place orders ahead at your business.
cost_note: The Clover mobile app is fast, friendly, and free on the App Store and Google Play.
quote: The Clover mobile app gives customers a simple way to earn rewards and order ahead at favorite businesses

name: Customer Engagement Plus automated win-back campaigns
description: A paid plan that includes automated win-back campaigns, targeted promos, and birthday rewards to bring back past customers.
cost_note: That’s a lot more customer engagement power for just $99/mo. Terms & conditions apply.
how_to_start: Sign up for the Clover Plus plan.
Schedule promos for the week from your Clover POS.
Check how each promo performs in your POS.
quote: automated win-back campaigns, and so much more

name: Customer history tracking
description: The platform keeps a record of each customer's past visits and preferences in one place.
quote: Track customer history to understand your client preferences to maximize their loyalty

name: Email appointment reminders
description: The platform sends email reminders to customers about upcoming appointments to reduce no-shows.
quote: Send email reminders to keep your customers up to date.

name: Gift cards, loyalty programs, and promotions
description: Tools let businesses offer gift cards, loyalty programs, and promotions to bring customers back.
quote: Encourage easy purchasing with gift cards, loyalty programs and promotions

name: Loyalty rewards with birthday and welcome bonuses
description: Create loyalty rewards, bonuses for regular customers, birthday bonuses, and welcome bonuses for new loyalty members.
cost_note: Customer Engagement Plus plan is $99/mo.
quote: Birthday bonuses to give your customers extra love on their special day.

name: Online appointment booking
description: Customers can book their own appointments online, which cuts down on manual booking by staff.
quote: Let your customers book appointments online

name: Draft with Copilot
description: Writes full email drafts from a short prompt, using the email thread and work information.
cost_note: The feature is available to customers with a Microsoft Copilot (work) license.
how_to_start: Open a new message or reply in Outlook.
Select the Copilot button on the ribbon, or type /.
Select Draft with Copilot.
Enter your prompt in the dialog box and review the draft before sending.
quote: Generates full-length email drafts from prompts based on thread context and organizational information.

name: Fast appointment scheduling in Gmail
description: Lets you offer open times in your inbox so customers can book appointments without a back-and-forth of emails.
cost_note: Workspace with Gemini is "included with any of our business plans."
quote: Now, with fast appointment scheduling integrated into Gmail, you can easily offer times for customers or clients to book, without ever leaving your inbox.

name: Help me write in Gmail
description: Gmail drafts new emails or rewrites existing text from a short prompt you type.
cost_note: If you have a personal Google Account, you can use these Gemini in Gmail features at no charge in the US: Help me write, AI Overviews for email threads, Suggested Replies
how_to_start: Open Gmail and click Ask Gemini at the top right.
Type a short prompt describing the email you need.
Review the draft, edit it, and send it.
quote: Draft new emails or refine existing text based on a prompt.

name: Personalized smart replies in Gmail
description: Gemini drafts email replies using your past emails and Drive files, matching your usual tone.
cost_note: Workspace with Gemini is "included with any of our business plans." The page says this feature is generally available later this year.
quote: Personalized smart replies in Gmail will help you draft emails that match your specific context and your tone.

name: Suggested replies in Gmail
description: Gmail offers reply suggestions at the bottom of an email so you can answer faster.
cost_note: If you have a personal Google Account, you can use these Gemini in Gmail features at no charge in the US: Help me write, AI Overviews for email threads, Suggested Replies
how_to_start: Open Gmail and find an email thread.
Look for the Gemini icon at the top right of Gmail.
Check the reply suggestions shown at the bottom of the thread.
quote: Select detailed, context-aware reply suggestions at the bottom of an email thread.

name: Draft review replies
description: Draft replies to customer reviews on your Google Business Profile, then post or delete them.
how_to_start: Go to gemini.google.com and sign in with the same account you use for your Business Profile.
Connect Google Business Profile to Gemini Apps when prompted, and follow the on-screen steps.
Ask Gemini to help draft a reply to a recent review.
Check the draft, then use it as your reply.
quote: Draft or delete replies to customer feedback.

name: Appointment scheduling
description: Lets customers and leads book phone or video meetings with you directly inside QuickBooks.
cost_note: Included with QuickBooks Essentials and above. Essentials is listed at $85, then $42.50/mo for 3 months. Feature is in beta.
quote: Let your customers and leads schedule phone or video meetings with you.

name: Customer AI
description: Automates lead generation, qualification, and nurturing, and removes manual data entry for client tasks and notes.
quote: It helps you get leads, focus on high-value opportunities, automate outreach, and manage proposals.

name: Customer AI draft email replies
description: Writes draft replies to lead emails that you can change in tone or length before you send them.
how_to_start: Go to the Leads page and select Review draft response for the lead.
Choose one of the three drafts, or ask for a tone rewrite or shorter length.
Add your signature and select Send.
quote: It provides 3 draft responses to choose from, based on the conversation.

name: Customer AI lead finder
description: Finds potential customers in your Gmail or Outlook inbox and ranks them as Hot or Warm so you can follow up.
how_to_start: Sign in as the Primary admin.
Go to All apps, then Customer Hub, then Opportunities.
Select Import leads from your inbox, choose Gmail or Outlook, and grant access.
Select Sync now.
quote: The Customer AI helps you manage potential customers by automating lead sourcing and prioritization from your Gmail or Outlook inbox.

name: Automated win-back emails
description: Ready-made email automations, including win-back emails, send to customers without you writing each message. Turn one on and it runs.
cost_note: Shopify Messaging is available on all Shopify plans. Send up to 10,000 emails free each month, then $1 USD per 1,000 additional emails.
how_to_start: Open Shopify Messaging and choose an automation template, such as winback.
Edit the email so it sounds like your brand.
Turn on the automation.
quote: Choose from ready-to-use automations like welcome, winback, and upsell emails.

name: Automations
description: Sends automatic marketing emails based on customer actions, such as abandoned carts or first purchases.
cost_note: Included in most Shopify plans.
how_to_start: Choose an automation template.
Edit the email.
Turn the automation on.
quote: Quickly set up automatic workflows with templates, or create your own, and streamline your marketing efforts. Included in most Shopify plans.

name: Email campaigns to customer segments
description: Send an email campaign to a customer list or segment, with personalized content, to reach the right people.
cost_note: Shopify Messaging is available on all Shopify plans. Send up to 10,000 emails free each month, then $1 USD per 1,000 additional emails.
quote: Pick from your customer lists or customer segments, personalize your email, and reach the right audience with the right message.

name: Segmentation
description: Groups customers automatically based on what they buy, view, or click, so you can send targeted messages.
cost_note: Included in all Shopify Plans.
quote: Segments automatically add or remove customers based on behaviors like viewing or buying products, getting tagged, or interacting with emails.

name: Shopify Forms
description: Captures customer names, emails, and other details from forms and adds them to your marketing lists.
cost_note: Included in most Shopify plans.
quote: Attract, acquire, and convert new customers with Shopify Forms, a free lead capture solution.

name: Shopify Inbox agent
description: Automatically answers customer chats on your online store about products, shipping, returns, sizing, and store policies.
how_to_start: Install Shopify Inbox from the Shopify App Store.
Open the Inbox page in your Shopify admin.
Turn on the Inbox agent and choose which conversations it handles.
Set its persona and train it using your catalog, policies, and files.
quote: Shopify Inbox includes an Inbox agent that you can turn on to chat with customers automatically.

name: Shopify Inbox AI suggested replies
description: Uses AI to suggest replies to customer chat messages during conversations.
cost_note: Included in all Shopify Plans.
quote: Use AI to automatically generate suggested replies during conversations with customers.

name: Shopify Messaging
description: Lets you create and send email and SMS marketing campaigns from templates or from scratch, then see results.
cost_note: Your first 10,000 emails are free every month. Then you pay $1/1000 emails, with volume pricing after 300,000 emails. SMS marketing is charged separately.
quote: Create email and SMS campaigns from scratch or from templates, send with flexible pricing, and report on results.

name: Sidekick email campaign help
description: Sidekick is Shopify's built-in AI assistant that can help you write and plan email marketing campaigns for your store.
cost_note: Sidekick is included with your Shopify plan. Features and usage limits vary by plan.
how_to_start: Open your Shopify admin.
Click the purple glasses icon to open Sidekick.
Ask Sidekick to build an email marketing campaign for your store.
quote: Build an effective email marketing campaign

name: SMS marketing campaigns
description: Send text message campaigns with offers and updates, using templates, and track results alongside email.
cost_note: SMS marketing is charged separately.
quote: SMS marketing is charged separately.

name: AI-powered booking management
description: Uses AI to help manage customer appointment bookings.
quote: Learn about AI-powered booking management

name: AI-powered voice ordering
description: Takes customer orders by phone automatically, so orders still get taken when staff can't answer.
quote: Serve customers faster and never miss a sale with automated voice ordering and messaging.

name: Automated appointment reminders
description: The platform automatically sends appointment reminders to customers by text and email.
quote: Send automatic appointment reminders to customers via SMS and/or email.

name: Automated marketing campaigns
description: Sends automated campaigns to bring clients back, including a Lapsed Booker automation for customers who stop booking.
cost_note: Additional fee
quote: Encourage repeat bookings with customized and automated campaigns, or the new Lapsed Booker automation.

name: Customer loyalty program
description: Lets you create a loyalty program to encourage customers to keep coming back.
cost_note: Additional fee
quote: Square Loyalty allows you to create a loyalty program to keep customers coming back.

name: Customer profiles and notes
description: Stores customer profiles and notes so you can remember details like birthdays and preferences.
quote: Build relationships with customers by keeping profiles on file.

name: Free online booking website
description: Customers can book appointments online at any time through a booking website you customize.
cost_note: Free online booking website
quote: Free online booking website Let your customers find and book your services online 24/7 with an easy-to-use website that reflects your style.

name: Import existing customers
description: You can bring customer records from another database into the appointments system.
quote: If you have customers in another database already, import them easily into Square Appointments.

name: Professional estimates and invoices
description: Send estimates and invoices with automatic customer reminders and track payments in real time.
quote: Send professional estimates and invoices with automatic customer reminders.

name: Square Assistant
description: An automated text tool that helps clients confirm, cancel, or reschedule appointments at any time of day.
cost_note: It's free and manages all your payments and booking needs.
quote: Square Appointments comes with Square Assistant

name: Square Messages
description: Puts text and email conversations with customers in one place so you do not have to switch apps.
quote: Square Messages puts text and email threads between you and your customers in one place.

name: Waitlist
description: You can create a waitlist to fill open spots caused by last-minute cancellations or reschedules.
quote: Create a waitlist for popular services and fill gaps in your schedule due to last-minute cancellations or reschedules.

name: AI Email Campaign Builder
description: Writes email subject lines and content from a short prompt, then lets you edit and schedule the email to guests.
how_to_start: Log in to Toast Web and select Marketing > Assistant > Campaigns.
Enter a prompt for your campaign, such as Trivia Night.
Review and edit the subject, title, body, and call-to-action.
Select Schedule email to send it.
quote: Toast’s Generative AI-Powered Marketing Assistant allows you to provide inputs, which

name: AI Personalized Campaign Plan
description: Creates a calendar of email, SMS, Facebook, and Instagram campaigns based on your restaurant data and past campaigns.
how_to_start: Navigate to Marketing > Assistant.
Select the purple Review marketing plan button in the purple banner.
Review the generated Marketing Plan Preview and edit campaigns as needed.
Select Schedule in the Campaign Builder to send each campaign.
quote: create a personalized calendar of marketing campaigns across your Toast marketing platforms

name: Toast IQ campaign drafts
description: Toast IQ drafts email or text marketing campaigns for you to review, edit, and send or schedule yourself.
how_to_start: Ask your Toast Web administrator for the 4.1 Sales Reports or 4.3 Labor Reports permission.
Open Toast IQ from the top left of the Toast Web navigation menu, or from the bottom of the Toast Now app.
Ask for a draft, such as "Draft an email campaign for our summer sale."
Review the draft in the linked campaign, then send or schedule it yourself.
quote: Draft marketing campaigns right from Toast IQ!
